configurations.judgment: RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY; slower one-drop flyer/connection development and forced tapped Crumbling Necropolis remain compared with D and selected rev2. Keeps Forerunner's tutor/drain; historic approval independent of this pool.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE; five early-evasion changes are coherent, but D retains 5U Palisade rather than 4R Wave and can fail against opposing Pirate blockers when Open is unavailable. Palisade returns non-Pirates persistently and can outperform Wave in attrition pods.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE; both this and selected rev2 have Wave and repeated Bident draw. This alternative retains Palisade's lasting non-Pirate bounce, but loses Fiery Cannonade's 2R instant small-creature defense, which is material in an attack-first creature deck.

PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_AWAITING_EXACT_TESTED_POOL_I; 6 actual canonical replacements, one-tempo-turn broad unblock when available while retaining Cannonade, Bident, Indomitable, Kindred, Open, March and Path. Loss of persistent mass-bounce acknowledged.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE; flyer changes actual matchup-specific Pirate connection, but Kari Zev is also a Pirate and contributes first strike/menace plus a separate Monkey body to generic creature combat draw. No mass Wave without other evasion source.
RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE; same Wave+instant defense as selected with additional flyer, but cumulative loss of Kari's combat contribution is not a proven net gain across reversibly different blocker boards.

REJECT_AS_ALL_PURPOSE; Regalia for Bident loses repeated draws, Wave for Cannonade loses reactive 2-damage, Dreamcaller for Open loses three-target unblock+hit draws; larger swap count does not establish strength despite improved flyer sources.
